0.reason: non-blocking, noted at landing: the last recorded stage should name the retention sweep; recorded on the section's close comment

findings.text: non-blocking: the `publish` stage is entered after the per-project publish loop has already finished and immediately before sweep_retention, so a tick stuck in retention reports the stage `publish` — work that is done — contradicting the _enter docstring's claim that a stage a reader sees is one the tick has not yet finished; renaming the last stage to name the retention sweep, or entering it before the loop, would keep the reading honest.

non-blocking: the exported snapshot carries the store's heartbeat but the file is only rewritten from inside the tick, so during a minutes-long tick an off-node reader that falls through to the export still ages a fresh beat into `stopped` and the hook still emits the restart advice this node exists to suppress; the file is outside this node's fence and the manifest records the neighbouring fact, but its outside_scope entry says the export "can only read stopped or live" rather than that it can still read stopped wrongly, so the residual defect should be folded into a node owning station_obligations.py.

non-blocking: the fragment is prose only while docs/figures/work-is-never-stuck-behind-the-admission-loop/a-slow-station-still-reads-as-alive was a declared write path, and a two-axis diagram of beat age against tick age showing the stopped, slow and live regions is the clearest statement of what this section changes.

item_verdicts.diff: read both commits against 3922d93453721f6886dd7e9722aa6aeb56ac8d54 — 401028768b32 adds the beat thread, the five tick stages and the stage/tick-age reader, and 2af24e99d5 lands the evidence fragment; the reader's new state field is additive so the two unchanged `stale` consumers keep their behaviour.
item_verdicts.done_when: read the measure at the node prompt's FENCE — EVIDENCE line and compared it with tests/test_a_slow_station_still_reads_as_alive.py; all three named arms are present (slow with stage and age at lines 225-231, stopped within one window at lines 267-271, restart advice only for stopped at lines 328-344) and the arm that would fail without the thread asserts heartbeat_age_seconds <= WINDOW_SECONDS at line 231 after three windows of a blocked refresh.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is "keep the station's beat independent of how long its tick takes"; reckon/crew/station.py:67 adds StationBeat, started at reckon/crew/station.py:514 before the first tick, which writes the heartbeat from its own thread and own store handle, so the beat no longer waits on the tick.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it reports the gate at 3 passed EXIT=0, the negative control at 1 failed/2 passed EXIT=1, and the importer population at 124/2 base against 127/2 head, and it records the export path gap under outside_scope rather than claiming it.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's seven declared paths; the diff touches exactly five of them (reckon/crew/station.py, reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py, reckon/hooks/coordinator_obligations.py, tests/test_a_slow_station_still_reads_as_alive.py, docs/evidence/fragments/.../a-slow-station-still-reads-as-alive.html) and nothing outside them, with the declared figures directory left unused.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_slow_station_still_reads_as_alive.py:231 fails if the beat returns to the tick, which the recorded negative control demonstrates by reinstating exactly that change and reddening line 225, and each added assertion compares a value read back through obligation_snapshot.read_station_answer against clock-derived bounds rather than against anything the test passed in.
justifications.evidence: the gate is the file's own three arms and I re-ran `PYTHONPATH=<worktree> .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_a_slow_station_still_reads_as_alive.py` at head, which printed "3 passed in 9.88s", and the recorded negative-control.log shows the same file at "1 failed, 2 passed" with the first arm red at tests/test_a_slow_station_still_reads_as_alive.py:225.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/station.py:67 follows the surrounding SweepBeat idiom of a class holding its own thread and stop event, and the stage vocabulary lives once in reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py:326 with no plan label or version token in any new name.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/station.py:113 beats every STATION_BEAT_SECONDS on its own thread and reckon/crew/station.py:369 keeps the tick's own heartbeat write at the start of the tick only, so the beat no longer depends on tick duration.
justifications.reuse: StationBeat wraps station_store.StationStore.heartbeat (reckon/crew/station_store.py:454) and the reader extends the existing read_station_answer at reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py:482 rather than adding a second reader; searching reckon/ for a stoppable periodic-beat owner found only reckon/change_streams.py:601, a private detector loop of that class and not a reusable mechanism.
justifications.scope_discipline: all five changed paths are inside the manifest's declared write paths and no unrelated file appears in the diff against 3922d93453721f6886dd7e9722aa6aeb56ac8d54.
